note: Carrying (Dave 2026-10-20): weight in kg per single item. by_id wins over by_suffix (an item id that ends with the word); anything else is default_kg. The comfortable load is comfort_kg_per_body_kg x body weight (placeholder for strength). Past it you slow smoothly down to min_speed at hard_cap_ratio x the comfortable load; the server refuses to pick up more than that. load_effort x ratio^load_effort_power (ratio = carried / comfortable) is added to the effort of a moving player, so a pack at the limit tires you quickly even at a crawl.
